newsitem.title: USA: EDS wins Natl Institute of Health contract.
newsitem.headline: EDS wins Natl Institute of Health contract.

text.p: EDS Corp said on Tuesday it received a contract as part of the National Institutes of Health's chief information officer solutions and partners program that would enable EDS and other firms to compete for $1 billion in business.

Under terms of the five-year deal, EDS said it will provide information technology services to the National Institutes of Health program to include outsourcing, systems integration, telecommunications, information technology operations, and other services.
